name: chatgpt-exchange
title: ChatGPT Exchange
description: A dark ChatGPT exchange types and sends a prompt, streams an answer, assembles a four-row comparison table and scrolls back through the result. Prompt, answer, table and six beat times are variables; placement full (app with header and Russian keyboard) or top / bottom (a black chat card); holds the read-back frame to the end of the mount.
author: Jake Moran
